items.stem: A design that looks sharp on screen prints blurry and pixelated at the print shop. What most likely went wrong?

options.text: It was exported at low resolution or the wrong file type for print, so a print-ready export is needed
options.rationale: Correct: print needs adequate resolution and an appropriate file type such as print-quality PDF.
Canva can export print-ready files; the export settings were the issue.
Brightness does not cause pixelation; resolution does.

options.text: The design had too few elements
options.rationale: Element count does not determine print sharpness.

items.explanation: Correct: print needs adequate resolution and an appropriate file type such as print-quality PDF.

items.stem: Which TWO actions keep a set of designs consistent and on-brand across a team? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Setting up and applying a brand kit of colours, fonts and logos
options.rationale: Correct: a brand kit enforces consistent brand assets across designs.

options.text: Reusing approved brand templates as starting points
options.rationale: Correct: shared brand templates keep outputs consistent.

options.text: Letting each person pick any font they like
Changing the brand colours for every post

items.explanation: Correct: a brand kit enforces consistent brand assets across designs.

items.stem: A template looks like every other business's post. What is the most effective first change to make it feel bespoke?

options.text: Replace the stock imagery, colours and copy with the brand's own assets and message
options.rationale: Correct: swapping in genuine brand assets and message differentiates a template.

options.text: Add as many extra stickers as possible
options.rationale: Piling on elements adds clutter, not distinctiveness.
A rotation is a gimmick that does not convey the brand.

options.text: Make the font much larger everywhere
options.rationale: Oversizing type does not make a design on-brand.

items.explanation: Correct: swapping in genuine brand assets and message differentiates a template.
